value.hook: Read after the socket-lock parent-trust note, before carrying S292-001 forward or claiming fully anchored filesystem safety.
value.title: Socket lock closure proof and placement limits

sections.name: body
sections.value:
The socket-lock parent-trust review closed through three layers of executable defense: atomic O_NOFOLLOW at open; opened-descriptor regular-file, owner-UID and single-link checks before chmod/flock; and a real-directory owner/sticky/write-policy check before socket-side creation, with the existing trusted state-root fallback.

Focused closure evidence includes symlink refusal without touching an existing or dangling target, hardlink refusal, the private-directory matrix, production AttachLock::take fallback with no socket-side creation, and retained permission-narrowing/lock-contention tests (crates/tmux/src/control.rs:374-403,732-754,1379-1398). Descriptor-based checks prevent re-resolving the final pathname; they do not constitute directory-fd-anchored ancestor validation. Preserve that placement qualification and distinguish it from a demonstrated exploit.

Second-UID execution and UID-branch mutation were not performed. Exact-head CI execution of the focused tests is stronger attribution than an existing un-stamped local runner, even when that runner's six cases pass. C34 final-round proof should name these limits without converting additional mutants or fixtures into a third review gate.

magicWand/gift: the production lock symlink/hardlink/fallback regressions now encode the original trust-boundary lesson. Keep the exact test outcomes and source guards connected in future reviews; an aggregate green suite or a currently private socket directory alone is not the proof.

difficulties: local dependency-free TS readiness remains unavailable under C25 and is reported separately from exact-head CI and the shared Rust/native/smoke inventory. Do not repair or symlink shared dependencies for a read-only review, or duplicate another reviewer's full workspace gate.
